family_reports.body: Stolen my children’s childhoods. Ripped our family apart. Placed a child permanently with his abusive father. Aided and facilitated abuse and the abuser. Opened my eyes to the real system — it is NOT “broken”.. it’s a well oiled, smooth running.. money making, family breaking machine.

Took three healthy kids and emotionally abused them, along with their mother and maternal family, through repeated questioning by the court therapist, CPS, judge, and GAL. Took the children away from a loving mother based on false allegations, without due process or objective evidence. Full story is surreal. I consent to the use of my quotes as long as they do not mention or include mine or my children’s private information. I copied and pasted from some of my open claims.
